name: tower key
description_on_ground: A key of black iron lies here, warm to the touch, sigils running down its shaft.

name: orc tusk
description_on_ground: A yellowed orc tusk, roots and all, lies here.

name: daemon ichor
description_on_ground: A stoppered vial of something thick and faintly glowing lies here.

name: daemon horn
description_on_ground: A curling black horn, still warm at the root, lies here.

name: wyvern scale
description_on_ground: A scale the size of a hand, green-gold and hard as horn, lies here.

name: guild wand
description_on_ground: A wand of black wood bound in copper wire lies here, its tip scorched.

name: thunder rod
description_on_ground: A rod of black iron lies here, and the air around it crackles.

name: mage's circlet
description_on_ground: A thin silver circlet set with a clouded stone lies here.

name: warded robe
description_on_ground: A grey robe stitched with silver sigils lies here, unburned in all this ash.

name: mending crystal
description_on_ground: A cracked crystal lies here, glowing a soft and steady blue.

name: orc war-helm
description_on_ground: A heavy orc war-helm, dented and spiked, lies here.
